criteria: Does metadata.semanticRelation match the WordNet relation between sourceSenseId and targetSenseId?
Do sourceForm/targetForm correspond to lemmas of those synsets (allowing inventory spelling variants)?
Are sourceId/targetId consistent with those forms in the graph metadata provided?
Reject only clear technical errors (wrong relation, sense IDs do not support the link, form not in synset lemmas).
Do NOT score CEFR level, teachability, curriculum usefulness, or rarity for learners.
uncertain only if WordNet link is real but form/sense mapping to graph ids is ambiguous.
note: Prior pedagogical CEFR fitness review was incorrect process; archived under pedagogical-mistaken/.
